common:continue__note: Button label. Verb, imperative — advances to the next item. Max 12 chars.
common:start__note: Button label. Verb, imperative — begins a lesson or quest. Max 10 chars.
common:retry__note: Button in an error state. Encouraging, never apologetic.
common:back__note: Accessibility label for the back chevron. Describes the ACTION, not the icon.
common:close__note: Accessibility label for the X button. The action, not the icon.
common:cancel__note: Dismisses a dialog without acting. Pairs with a confirming action.
common:offline.banner: You're offline — lessons still work. We'll sync later.
common:offline.banner__note: Reassuring, not alarming. States what still works.
common:error.generic.title: That didn't load
common:loading__note: Accessibility label for a loading screen.
